name: Deer Fables: Beginnings
source:
"Deer Fables" Is an anthology series that follows the fantastical world of Dreamware. In this installment you will follow Marie, a stubborn deer girl, as she attempts to uncover the mystery behind a sudden curse afflicting her parents.

[From [url=https://mariaddity.itch.io/deer-fables-beginnings]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《鹿寓言》是一部讲述Dreamware奇幻世界的选集系列。在本集中，你将跟随玛丽，一个顽固的鹿女孩，尝试揭开困扰她父母的突然诅咒背后的谜团。

[来自[url=https://mariaddity.itch.io/deer-fables-beginnings]itch.io[/url]]
